QUIC stream pool footprint, initialization, allocation, and free functions.

# Purpose
`fd_quic_stream_pool.c` implements a fixed-size pool for `fd_quic_stream_t` objects used by the QUIC stream code. It provides functions to compute the memory footprint of the pool with [`fd_quic_stream_pool_footprint`](<#fd_quic_stream_pool_footprint>), create and initialize the pool with [`fd_quic_stream_pool_new`](<#fd_quic_stream_pool_new>), and manage stream lifetime with [`fd_quic_stream_pool_alloc`](<#fd_quic_stream_pool_alloc>) and [`fd_quic_stream_pool_free`](<#fd_quic_stream_pool_free>). The pool stores all streams in one allocated memory region and uses a linked-list free list, with `pool->head` acting as the sentinel node and `pool->cur_cnt` tracking the number of streams currently in the pool.

The file also defines [`fd_quic_stream_pool_delete`](<#fd_quic_stream_pool_delete>), which is present but does not release any resources, and [`fd_quic_stream_pool_free_batch`](<#fd_quic_stream_pool_free_batch>), which is a placeholder for future batch return logic. The code depends on stream list macros and stream constructor helpers from the QUIC stream implementation, and it expects the caller to provide aligned memory large enough for the pool and all managed streams.
